about: memprobe: a probe for open-field issue 15, READ mode. It watches the two stretches of DDR that OS 1.7.3 appears never to use (0x83800000-0x84000000, 0x84d30000-0x88000000 and 0x88040000-0x8c000000; the display's second frame buffer at 0x88000000 is left out) and says in the log whether anything else writes there, by checksums only: nothing is written. Its sibling memprobe-w (recipe_w.json) writes a pattern and checks every word. It changes no place of the firmware and needs the base (level 1).
name: memprobe
